inputs.original_text: Phoenix’s leaders are putting political posturing ahead of cooperation with the people responsible for enforcing the law. Whatever procedural language surrounds this vote, restricting ICE and other law enforcement agencies from using city property risks undermining public order. Families need safe communities and officials who respect the rule of law—not leaders who make enforcement harder.
inputs.modified_text: Phoenix’s leaders are making it harder for law enforcement to do its job, and calling it procedure doesn’t change the consequences. Restricting ICE and other agencies from using city property sends the wrong message: political priorities matter more than public order. Families deserve safe communities and officials who uphold the rule of law, not obstacles to its enforcement.
